notes: The star sits 15.6″ (2.5 pixels) away from the centre of these images. The images were centred on its catalogue position from years ago, and the star has moved since then. Measurements here follow the star, not the old position.
The team dataset labels this object “variable”. The label has not been checked scientifically.
This object is so bright that the centre of its image is saturated in 24 of 24 frames. Its brightness values here are not reliable; they show as hollow points in the charts.
